label: peer-reviewed papers, 2017 to 2026
takeaway: Protein, cells, bacteria and scar all measured, in vitro and in four animal and cadaver models.
source: Ten papers listed in figures/data/W24_publications.json (DOIs given there)

label: thinner fibrotic capsule around coated implants
takeaway: One year in mice, on human cochlear implant arrays, over platinum and silicone alike (Horne 2023).
source: Horne R, et al. Acta Biomaterialia 2023;166:212-223 (Fig 7I: 47 versus 18 micrometers, about 62 percent thinner, one year in mice)

label: issued US patents
takeaway: The photografting method and the coated-device system are protected.

label: patents granted in five countries
takeaway: United States, Australia, China, Japan and Mexico: the largest device markets.

label: less insertion force with coated cochlear implants
takeaway: Three studies: human cadaver cochleae twice and a synthetic cochlea (Bennion 2021, Peel 2024, SBIR dataset).
source: Bennion DM, et al. Otology and Neurotology 2021 (Fig 4A, 42 percent less); Peel A, et al. ACS Applied Bio Materials 2024 (Fig 13A, about 50 percent less); NIH SBIR Phase I dataset, Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.10459478 (64 percent less); see W07

label: film intact after implantation, mice
takeaway: The covalent graft was still intact at one year, and the scar capsule stayed thin.
source: Horne R, et al. Acta Biomaterialia 2023;166:212-223 (Fig 7)

label: functional human arrays in sheep
takeaway: Works on the real device: lower impedance and less inflammation on a working implant.
source: Ben-Shlomo N, et al. Hearing Research 2026;474:109606 (four weeks); six-month sheep cohort, ZwiCoat internal study, 2026

label: less protein, cell and bacterial adhesion and friction, published bench studies
takeaway: A tightly bound water shell turns away protein, cells and bacteria, so scar and biofilm have no foothold.
source: Leigh 2017, Leigh 2019, Jensen 2021, Shen 2021, Horne 2023, Bennion 2021, Peel 2024, Barrera 2026 (see W05; median of the plotted bars is about 94 percent, range about 53 to 99)
